positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what is the verified calibration status of the Kestrelwood spectrograph at 88.4 MHz?
positions.why: Both expressions come from the same speaker in flat technical register, moving from a stated calibration result to its verification against a named reference standard — one directional read tracing the instrument's calibration state from assertion to confirmed validity across the observing band. No tension: the second segment substantiates rather than contests the first.
